summary: Complete e2e testing of DrON Topografía - Authentication and Role-Based Access Control. All 32 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified admin and client role-based views work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT authentication properly implemented with bcrypt password hashing
Role-based access control correctly enforced on both backend and frontend
Admin-only endpoints properly protected with 403 responses for clients
Client can only see their own solicitudes (filtered by cliente_id)
Email notifications via Resend API configured for solicitud status updates
seed_data_creation: Admin and Client users already seeded in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Authentication system fully tested. Admin can: login, see all solicitudes, approve/reject solicitudes, manage users, CRUD on proyectos/vuelos. Client can: login, see read-only views, create new solicitudes, see their own solicitudes history. Email notifications via Resend API are configured for solicitud status updates.
